name: online-fashion-shopping-website
description: Full-stack Online Fashion Shopping Website with Express Backend & React Frontend running concurrently

scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
